H1, H2, then another H1 creates two sibling top-level groups

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"include_document_structure\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>Chapter One</h1><h2>Section A</h2><p>Section A content.</p><h1>Chapter Two</h1><h2>Section B</h2><p>Section B content.</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
